images.caption: Figure 1:Geometry and motion in a single forward pass.All reconstruction and tracking results are obtained in asingle network forward passper scene, including cases withover 1,000 input images.

Figure 3:𝛑𝟒\bm{\uppi^{4}}overview.Shared DINOv3 features feed geometry and motion loop decoders for reconstruction, dense tracking, and moving-object segmentation. A sparse 3D refiner improves local geometry, while detached geometry features condition motion through spatial adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN).

Figure 4:Scene-level view sampling.Labeled camera frusta correspond to the rendered views. Natural views use small roll and shared intrinsics; independently positioned counterbias views span broader roll and variable focal length. Labels report roll and vertical FOV. Illustrative camera configurations. Scene: Amazon Lumberyard Bistro(Amazon Lumberyard, 2017),CC BY 4.0; custom cameras, lighting, and overlays.
Figure 5:Internet-video data pipeline.Background geometry is reconstructed and filtered with moving-object masks.
Figure 6:Qualitative reconstruction comparison.Reconstructed point clouds and camera poses.

Figure 7:Qualitative 3D tracking comparison.Left: input frames. Remaining columns: reconstructed scenes and colored 3D trajectories from Track4World, MoSE3, ARROW, and𝛑𝟒\bm{\uppi^{4}}. From top to bottom: 97, 64, and 390 frames.

Figure 10:Motion parameterization.Top: local track–geometry close-ups; bottom: global tracks. ARROW regresses XYZ, MoSE3 predicts UV and depth, and𝛑𝟒\bm{\uppi^{4}}lifts UV through geometry. Independent depth can separate MoSE3 tracks from reconstructed surfaces; ours remain registered by construction.

Figure 11:Surface refinement without informative image conditioning.From left to right: convolutional-head output, and pretrained-refiner results with image-derived conditioning features replaced by zeros or random noise, respectively. Both settings improve local structure while increasing point-placement error. Each comparison pairs an overview with a close-up of the blue-boxed thin structure.
